subject: financial-literacy

location.unitTitle: PF2 — Buying Goods and Services: Comparing a Purchase Before You Make It

instructions: Use only the fictional or supplied figures. Do not disclose household income, accounts, balances, or spending.
Show computations for fixed items and explain the tradeoff or decision for open items.

learnerTasks.directions: The fictional options. Cedarline 14: $529, 128 GB storage, 1-year warranty. Pellham Flex: $649, 256 GB storage, 2-year warranty. Vantis Air: $479, 64 GB storage, 90-day warranty. An external drive that brings any model up to the required 256 GB costs $59 for the Cedarline and $110 for the Vantis.
learnerTasks.prompt: What does the Cedarline 14 cost in total to meet the 256 GB requirement?

learnerTasks.directions: The fictional options. Cedarline 14: $529, 128 GB storage, 1-year warranty. Pellham Flex: $649, 256 GB storage, 2-year warranty. Vantis Air: $479, 64 GB storage, 90-day warranty. An external drive that brings any model up to the required 256 GB costs $59 for the Cedarline and $110 for the Vantis.
learnerTasks.prompt: What does the Vantis Air cost in total to meet the requirement?

learnerTasks.directions: The fictional options. Cedarline 14: $529, 128 GB storage, 1-year warranty. Pellham Flex: $649, 256 GB storage, 2-year warranty. Vantis Air: $479, 64 GB storage, 90-day warranty. An external drive that brings any model up to the required 256 GB costs $59 for the Cedarline and $110 for the Vantis.
learnerTasks.prompt: Which model meets the storage requirement with no additional purchase?

learnerTasks.directions: Now put warranty coverage on the same scale as cost. Express the 90-day warranty in years as 0.25.
learnerTasks.prompt: What does the Pellham Flex cost per year of warranty coverage?

learnerTasks.directions: Now put warranty coverage on the same scale as cost. Express the 90-day warranty in years as 0.25.
learnerTasks.prompt: What does the Cedarline 14 cost per year of warranty coverage, counting the drive it needs?

learnerTasks.directions: Now put warranty coverage on the same scale as cost. Express the 90-day warranty in years as 0.25.
learnerTasks.prompt: What does the Vantis Air cost per year of warranty coverage, counting its drive?

Recommend one model. Your dossier must state the total cost to meet the requirement, the warranty position, and the one figure that decided it — and must say what you would need to learn to change your mind.
Warranty length is not the same as reliability. Explain the difference and say what the dossier would need in order to say anything about reliability.
